question: Which among the following nations won the 2019 Copa America Soccer Tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brazil** won their seventh **World Cup title after defeating Peru 3–1 in the final**.
 
• Argentina finished third after a 2–1 victory over Chile in the third-place match.
 
• **Copa América, formerly the South American Championship of Nations **(until 1975), is a quadrennial South American football (soccer) tournament that is the continent's top championship in the sport.
 
• The Copa América is the oldest international football competition in the world.
 
• The tournament was first conducted in 1916 to commemorate Argentina's 100th year of independence, with Uruguay winning the inaugural title.
 
• It was held every fourth year until 2007 when it switched to its present quadrennial structure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Copa América, **formerly known as the South American Football Championship until 1975, is the premier men's football event in South America.
 
• It is the** world's third most-watched football competition **and the oldest still running continental competition.
